book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Eibram i lus
Eibram bin gad nada oman apta Sera. Neim blo em Ketura.
Em bin bone siks boi pikinini po Eibram ane kole dempla, Zimran, Zoksan, Medan, Midian, Isbak ane Sua.
Zoksan i bin papa blo Siba ane Dedan. Ane dem pamlelain blo Dedan i bin dem pipol blo Asur, Letus ane dem pipol blo Lium.
Dem boi pikinini blo Midian i bin Epa, Eper, Anok, Abida, ane Elda. Ebri demwan ya i bin ol pikinini blo Ketura.
Eibram i bin meke main blo em po gibe ebri gudsamting blo em po Aizak.

Bat po dem boi pikinini blo ol dem nada oman blo Eibram, wen Eibram bin stil laip em bin gibe ol mina gudsamting po dempla. Den em bin sanewei dempla prom boi blo em Aizak, go po dem lan lo istsaid. Eibram no bin wande dempla po stap lo seimples wea Aizak i bin stap.
Eibram i bin kese 175 iya oul.
Eibram i bin prapa oulman wen em bin lus. Em bin gad prapa long ane gudlaip. Wen em bin ole laswin blo em, em bin go ane zoine ol pamle blo em uda bin pinis ded.
Tu boi blo Eibram, Aizak ane Ismaiel i bin bere em insaid lo da keib blo Makpela wea lan blo Epron. Epron em i boi blo Zoar da It man, ane dis lan i bin lo istsaid blo Mamre.
Diswan lan wea Eibram i bin baiem wea da mitingples blo dem pipol blo It. Demtu bin bere em de wea Sera, oman blo em.
Apta wen Eibram bin ded, God i bin meke ol mina prapa gudsamting po Aizak. Ane Aizak bin go po stap de lo Bilairoi wea eria blo Negeb.
Ismaiel gad tuelb boi pikinini
Diswan ya stori blo pamlelain blo Ismaiel. Mama blo Ismaiel i bin Eiga da sleib oman, wea Sera uda bin gibem po Eibram po bi nada oman po em.
Ya nau dem neim blo dem boi pikinini blo Ismaiel. Neim blo dempla i stat prom da bigwan wen dempla bin bon. Nebaiot, em pas boi blo Ismaiel, ane Kedar, Adbil, Mibsam,
Misma, Duma, Masa,
Adad, Tema, Zetur, Napis, ane Kedema.
Prom dem tuelb boi pikinini dem tuelb pamlelain bin stat. Ebriwan kare neim blo dempla oun pamlelain ane dempla stap lo dempla oun ples.
Ismaiel i bin kese 137 iya oul. Em bin ole laswin blo em ane em bin zoine ol pamle blo em uda bin pinis ded.

Dem pamlelain blo Ismaiel bin lego go po stap lo da lan melen wea Abila ane Sur. Dis lan i lo istsaid lo kantri blo Izipt, wea da bigrod wea i go po lan blo Asu. Ane Ismaiel ane pamlelain blo em i bin stap nada ples prom dem nada pamlelain blo Eibram bikoz ol bin gense wananada.
Iso ane Zekop bin bon
Diswan ya stori blo pamlelain blo Aizak. Em boi blo Eibram ane Eibram bin papa blo Aizak.
Wen Aizak bin kese 40 iya oul, em bin kam man blo Ribeka. Ribeka bin gel blo Betuel. Betuel em man blo Aram prom kantri blo Mesapotamia ane Ribeka i bin gad wan bala neim Laban.

Aizak bin prea po AntapGod po aske da AntapGod po elpe oman blo em bikoz em no bin gad pikinini yet. Ane da AntapGod i bin mekem wanem Aizak i bin aske em po mekem, ane apta, Ribeka i bin kam pamle wea tuin.
Dem boi pikinini i bin prapa pus gense wananada insaid beli blo Ribeka. I bin wase demtu pait gense wananada. Ane Ribeka bin aske da AntapGod diskain, ‘Aukam disting i apen po mi?’

Ane da AntapGod i bin spik po Ribeka, ‘Yu gad tu boi pikinini insaid beli blo yu ane demtu go kam tu ate blo tu dipren dipren pamlelain blo pipol. Demtu boi pikinini wea i go kamaut prom yu, demtu go gad pikinini ane dempla pamlelain go prapa pait gense wananada. Pamlelain blo wan boi pikinini i gobi mostrong den pamlelain blo da nadawan. Da pas boi pikinini i go kam sebant blo da las boi pikinini.’
Wen i bin taim blo Ribeka po bon, em bin bone tu beibi.
Pas boi pikinini i bin kamaut gad prapa red skin. Em gad tumas eya wase em bin were wan kout blo animal skin. Apta, dempla bin kolem Iso
Stretwei sekan boi pikinini i bin kamaut tu. Em bin kese leg blo Iso taitwan kam ausaid. Da sekanwan i bin kolem Zekop
. Aizak i bin 60 iya oul wen Ribeka i bin bone demtu boi pikinini.
Iso bin sele rait blo em

Wen demtu boi pikinini i bin kam bigman nau, Iso bin dedli man po anting. Em bin man uda laik wagbaut ausaid lo bus, bat Zekop i bin dipren. I bin kuaiat man uda bin mata stap ane wok klostu po wea dempla i stap.
Aizak bin prapa laik Iso, bikoz em bin laik po kaikai dem mit blo dem bus animal wea Iso i bin kilem. Bat Ribeka i bin prapa laik Zekop.
Wantaim Zekop i bin kuke sup. Den Iso i bin kam prom anting ane i bin mina prapa taiat ane anggre.
Iso spik diskain po Zekop, ‘Yagar. Ai prapa anggre! Ariap. Gibe mi sam red bezdabol sup.’ (Diswan wiskain em bin gede dis nada neim blo em, Edom, wea i min ‘red’.)
Zekop ansa po em diskain, ‘Orait! Bat pas yu mas gibem po mi dem rait blo da pasbon boi pikinini, bikoz yu da bigwan prom yumi. Den apta ai go gibe yu sam sup.’
Iso i spik gen, ‘Wa, tekem, i blo yu. Ariap, ai tingk ai go ded prom anggre. Wiskain dem rait blo da pasbon boi go elpe mi nau bikoz ai prapa anggre?’

Zekop i bin spik prapa strong po Iso diskain, ‘Orait. Bat pas, yu mas meke strongpromis, yu go gibe mi dem rait blo da pasbon boi pikinini bikoz yu bigbala prom yumi.’ So Iso bin meke promis po em, ane Iso bin sele rait blo da pasbon boi po Zekop.

Den Zekop i bin gibe Iso sam bred ane sam sup, ane Iso bin mina lego po kaikai. Apta wen em belipul em bin lego go. Tru gar! Iso no bin kea o gad eni piling em i bin gibe dem rait blo da pasbon boi po bala blo em.

footnotes.text: Iso wea langus blo dem Zuwispipol i min ‘tumas eya’.
Zekop wea langus blo dem Zuwispipol i min ‘em kese leg’.
